rawContent: We get the verdict, and then we find out that a 15 year old girl was shot FOUR TIMES by the police. #MakiyahBryant #SayHerName #BlackLivesMatter

It’s wild the amount of Black men I see capping for the cops in this #MakhiaBryant situation. It furthers goes to show that many Black men don’t give a damn about Black women/girls unless it suits them. Like do #BlackLivesMatter only if they are men? #SayHerName #blackwomenmatter

Black women matter, the health of Black women matter. Black mother’s matter. So as you celebrate your mothers, as you celebrate how they have loved you. Remember that many didn't make it because their lives weren't valued. #BlackLivesMatter  #blackwomenmatter #MothersDay
